preservation.defaultOff: Only exact System.getenv STUDIO_C5_CLAIM_DIAGNOSTIC equals true instantiates sampler within activeC5. Null otherwise; no registration/sampling/newwrite. Existing normalC5 fields/calls preserved.

integration.filter: Existing selected /claim actual executing Thread enterbefore SAMEoriginalchain once and leavefinally; all original wrapper/method/path/headers/body/status/error/authority/provider/schema/clock/TRACE/deadline calls unchanged.
integration.privacy: Public Thread.getStackTrace only registered original claimthreads; classify fixed segment/threadstate count matrix, discard rawstack/snapshot immediately. No threadnames/IDs/args/body/path/hash/dates/rawframes/Throwable output.
integration.cleanup: Independent stop/clear registry/interrupt ONLY sampler/boundedjoin/restore caller interrupt. Only joined matrix readable; nonjoined statusNON_QUIESCENT, cleanupUnconfirmed=true, no counter fields/clean-no-ref claim, original failure preserved via existing p3AttemptTeardown/suppressed handling. FAILED cannot become OBSERVED in later samples; NON_QUIESCENT also sticky.
integration.writer: Reuse ONLY existing c5-numeric-evidence.json after samplerclose; merges fixednumeric status/diagnostic/joined/cleanup booleans plus matrix/cycles/empty/unattributed counts only ifjoined. No samplerfile/newchannel. Preserve prior existing fields and remove stale counter keys on nonjoin.
integration.unsupported: Public virtual stack API canretry/yield without timed/interrupted guarantee; NON_QUIESCENT invalidates measurement; no targetinterrupt/Thread.stop or hidden deadline increase. Empty/deep/unrelated counts UNOBSERVED, not false absence proof.

limits: Approximate stack/state samples, not atomic/exclusiveCPU/row-lock proof. Sampling may perturb near1000ms request; actual sampled gate diagnostic only, original unprofiled acceptance remains required. No performance/rootcause/C5PASS/all19 claim.

verification.next: Root applied-source review then coordinator exact scoped compile+existingfirst/ninth diagnostic; no B execution

actions: Single authorized Publication Java and own evidence only; no main/SDK/DDL/schema/runtime/SQL/Node/Gradle/model action.
